chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense and All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, then Coral Guard.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Coral Guard with Pearl Barrage, Exhausting Coral Guard, for more damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the extra damage from Pearl Barrage in exchange for 5 Block against the telegraphed 12-damage attack.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not intended to attack, I would have favored Pearl Barrage over Coral Guard.
